title: Open Mic Wednesday Friends Day @ Theodore's Booze Blues & BBQ
event_description: Every Wednesday night open mic featuring live house band backup. Any musical style welcome - original or cover songs. Musicians choose which house band members back their set. Full equipment provided - no purchase required to participate.
backline: Full PA System Drums Bass Keyboard Guitar Amp Provided
event_venue_information:
Theodore's Booze Blues & BBQ - Named Best Blues Club in the Country

Theodore's Booze Blues & BBQ is a legendary live music venue located at 201 Worthington Street in Springfield's Entertainment District. Since 1979 the venue has been a mainstay for blues and barbecue in Springfield. In 2004 The Blues Foundation recognized Theodore's with a KBA Award (Keeping the Blues Alive) naming it Best Blues Club in the Country.

Wednesday Open Mic Format

Every Wednesday night from 9:30pm-1am Theodore's hosts an innovative open mic format. Musicians sign up for desired time slots (typically 20 minutes). Each performer chooses which house band musicians they want backing their set - can choose a solo backup or full band support. The house band is equipped to back acoustic performers electric players and full ensembles. This flexible approach allows performers to customize their experience.

House Band Excellence

Theodore's provides a professional house band that includes drums bass keyboard and guitar players. These are experienced musicians familiar with blues standards rock covers and original material. The level of backup is professional and support the performers without overwhelming them.

BBQ & Food

Theodore's specializes in hickory-smoked barbecue prepared fresh daily. Meats include hand-rubbed ribs pulled pork sliced brisket chicken and sausage. Traditional sides include cornbread with honey butter honey slaw baked beans and collard greens. Fresh food and great music combine to create an full entertainment experience.

Blues Foundation Recognition

In 2004 The Blues Foundation - the official nonprofit organization dedicated to preserving blues music - recognized Theodore's with a Keeping the Blues Alive (KBA) Award and named it Best Blues Club in the Country. This prestigious recognition validates the venue's commitment to blues music and community.

Live Music Seven Nights

Beyond Wednesday open mic Theodore's features live music performances seven nights a week. The programming ranges from local blues acts to regional and national touring artists. The 1979 establishment date and consistent commitment to music make Theodore's a Springfield institution.
